CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  25-56339  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Advisory Commission on Aging
  meeting of Wednesday, August 13, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  25-56344  Recommendation to receive and file an update on Citywide Senior Programming
  from Recreation Superintendent, Heidi Mazas.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  25-56342  Recommendation to review 2023 Senior commission Visibility Plan and decide
  which items to keep and if any items need to be added.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  25-56343  Recommendation to receive and file an update from the ad hoc committee on
  benefits for low income seniors.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.
